content.text: Give the color ordering of the green, red, yellow, and blue dots that point to (in order) the plug, tip of the right gripper, cable, tip of the left gripper. Choices:  A. Red, green, blue, yellow. B. Red, green, yellow, blue. C. Blue, green, red, yellow. D. Red, yellow, blue, green. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
